example_shared_block: When clients voluntarily leave their employment, the officer must determine if they had just cause for leaving. Just cause means that when all factors are considered, the client had no reasonable alternative but to leave the employment. If it is determined that the client left the employment without just cause, a disqualification is imposed on the claim for regular benefits, unless the client has worked enough insurable hours since the voluntary leaving to establish a new claim. In this case, the ROE with the voluntary leaving is excluded from the calculation of the claim.
